unguardedMeaningChanges: The transition from the cold-open sales/growth hook to the editor's project-time 0:00 replay was not tested as a cross-window visual match; the candidate instead encoded the opening as a separate sample.
unguardedRelationships: Cold open (0.00-3.23) is the opening of the Labubu editor project (17.25-19.50), evidenced by repeated BEFORE/AFTER and growth scenes plus matching sales-script content.
metaAudit.rationale: All available carrier classes were nominally inspected, but the protocol's CA-01 and REL-04 embedded the wrong prior ('opening non-Labubu sample') and never required direct opening-to-editor frame matching. Consequently KU-19, REL-04, CQ-07, the article, and the candidate's own metaGate all preserve the same consequential relationship error. Under the meta-gate invariant, this is a hard failure even though the numeric content gates otherwise clear their thresholds.
